answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond in a shared vault before it may answer, with the bond slashed if a jury finds copied or template work. Like light through a prism, one real operator's record splits into a verifiable history of distinct, graded contributions, while a Sybil farm's plume of near-identical submissions reveals itself at once. A genuine agent pays once and earns the bond back over time, but an attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake identity and loses each one when caught, so cloning identities costs more than any reward the fakes could earn.
